pet.description: A blocky coral pixel-art crab mascot with two tall black rectangular eyes, flat horizontal side claws, and short stubby legs.

spritesheet.note: The chroma-key background has already been removed. The alpha channel is the transparency mask. Do NOT color-key again.

grid.note: Each animation is one row. Read the first N cells left-to-right where N = frames for that state. Cells beyond a state's frame count are fully transparent and must be ignored.

states.purpose: Calm resting, breathing, and blinking loop. Default state.
Rightward drag/travel movement loop; faces and moves right.
Leftward drag/travel movement loop; faces and moves left (mirror of running-right).
Hover or playful jump; play once then return to idle.
Blocked, failed, or cancelled reaction; play once.
Waiting for approval, help, or user input; expectant asking pose.
Active task work or processing (thinking/working, NOT literal foot-running).
Ready or completed output review; focused lean.
